items.title: Payments in Europe: towards a new strategic architecture
items.summary: The European Central Bank (ECB), through the Eurosystem, has set out its new comprehensive payment strategy, positioning payments as a key pillar for Europe’s competitiveness, innovation and strategic autonomy. In the context of rapid digitalization and increasing reliance on non-European providers, the strategy adopts a holistic approach that combines the enhancement of existing infrastructures with the development of new solutions, aiming to build a more resilient, integrated and competitive European payments ecosystem.
